title.zh: 完整生成比较下的组织形成要求
title.en: Required organization under whole generative comparison

statement.zh: 在有限非空的合格接续中，若每种缺少某项组织关系的接续都有充分更好的合格构造，则所有未被击败的选择都包含该关系；这可支持建设或增强共同能力而不预定唯一承载。
statement.en: In a finite nonempty eligible range, if every continuation lacking an organizational relation has a strictly better eligible construction, every undefeated choice includes that relation. This can warrant building or strengthening shared capacity without fixing one carrier.

hypotheses.zh: G0、明确 J1–J4 与完整关系对应；不是从一元本体单独推出伦理。
hypotheses.en: G0, explicit J1–J4 and complete relational correspondence; ethics is not deduced from monism alone.

hypotheses.zh: 有限非空的合格范围、严格传递比较、每个缺失情形的实际改善见证；规范资格与基本分类仍须辩护。
hypotheses.en: A finite nonempty eligible range, irreflexive transitive comparison and actual improvement witnesses for every deficient case; normative eligibility and basic classifications require substantive warrant.

correspondence.zh: 同一支持历史形成连接、保留基础并承担休闲损失；甲乙是作用路径。具体模型的合格谓词只表示物理可行，不能独自认证现实权限。
correspondence.en: One support history forms links, retains a basis and bears an opportunity loss; the two carriers are routes. Concrete eligibility means physical feasibility only and does not certify real authority.

detail.zh: PracticalJudgment.finite_frontier 与 dominated_excluded 的输出经 formation_required_of_improvable_absence 接成 Required；规范解释继承公开 J 承诺。
detail.en: PracticalJudgment.finite_frontier and dominated_excluded feed formation_required_of_improvable_absence to produce Required; normative interpretation inherits the explicit J commitments.

detail.zh: 复用已完成的跨智能方向，推进组织形成的具体条件。
detail.en: Reuses the completed cross-intelligence direction to advance the conditions of organizational formation.

detail.zh: 后续分类稳健命题补足一类未定分类下的改善输入；不替换原组织结果。
detail.en: The later robust-classification result supplies improvement inputs in unsettled cases without replacing the original organizational result.

detail.zh: 过度建设实际耗尽生活基础；相同的建设报告不能判定基础。增加真实余量可修复本例的观察遗漏。
detail.en: Overbuilding actually depletes the living basis; identical construction reports fail to classify it. Faithful retained-amount information repairs this local omission.

does_not_show.zh: 一般生成结构未充分推出陌生新生活的基本内容。
does_not_show.en: General generative structure does not supply full basic-content correspondence for unfamiliar new living.

does_not_show.zh: 规范要求不推出必然服从。
does_not_show.en: The requirement does not establish inevitable compliance.
It does not derive complete institutional authority.

progress.zh: 一元重构：组织评价从同一生成历史出发；生生之意义给出正面意义，比较与基本保护优先的承诺给出有范围的比较力度，有限范围给出非空的未被击败选择。
progress.en: Monist reconstruction: organizational appraisal starts from one generative history; living significance supplies positive significance, the commitments of comparison and basic-condition priority scoped comparative force, and finite scope a nonempty undefeated range.

progress.zh: 已检查的组合：实践判断的未被击败范围与支配排除接成组织形成要求；具体历史要求一项协调功能，两种承载均可。
progress.en: Checked composition: practical judgment's undefeated range and dominance exclusion yield the formation requirement; a worked history requires a coordinating function that either of two carriers can bear.

progress.zh: 检验的界限：过度建设的历史保留，建设报告的观察遗漏已修复；组织必要性、更多结构或当前认识都未提供陌生新生活的基本内容。
progress.en: Tested limit: the overbuilding history is kept and the construction-report omission repaired; organizational necessity, more structure or present recognition do not supply the basic content of unfamiliar new living.

progress.zh: 分类稳健比较：一类基本地位未定的情形中也得出形成要求（classification-robust-generative-comparison）。
progress.en: Robust classification: formation requirements also follow in a class of unsettled-basic-status cases (classification-robust-generative-comparison).

validation_scope.zh: 13项新 Lean 定理声明／29项声明审计；另重编30项继承定理／46项审计。含应用及定义对应，不是13个规范公理证明。作者反审；无独立 agent 验收。无经验验证。
validation_scope.en: 13 new Lean theorem declarations/29 declaration audits, with 30 inherited theorems/46 audits separately rebuilt. Includes applications and a definitional identity, not 13 normative-axiom proofs. Author counterreview; no independent-agent acceptance. No empirical validation.

next_delta.zh: 复用分类稳健比较。具体方案因真实生活作用分类而改变时，落实会改变决定的实质对应；不把全部陌生生活分类设为建设前提。
next_delta.en: Reuse robust classification. Where living-role classification changes implementation, establish decision-relevant substantive correspondence without requiring classification of all unfamiliar living before construction.
